sections.title: Graphs of Quadratic Expressions
sections.content: y = ax² + bx + c represents a parabola. If a > 0, it opens upwards; if a < 0, downwards. The vertex is always at (-b/2a, -D/4a).

sections.title: Location of Roots
sections.content: Involves setting conditions for roots to lie in specific intervals (e.g., both roots > k). It requires checking D ≥ 0, the sign of a*f(k), and vertex position (-b/2a).

sections.title: AM-GM-HM Inequality
sections.content: For positive real numbers, Arithmetic Mean ≥ Geometric Mean ≥ Harmonic Mean (AM ≥ GM ≥ HM). Equality holds only when all numbers are identical.

sections.title: Infinite Geometric Series
sections.content: If the common ratio strictly satisfies |r| < 1, the sum of infinite terms converges to a finite value. Formula: S_infty = a / (1 - r).

sections.title: Arithmetico-Geometric Progression (AGP)
sections.content: A sequence where each term is the product of corresponding terms of an AP and a GP. Example: a, (a+d)r, (a+2d)r²...

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
1) Applying AM-GM to negative numbers.
2) Forgetting to check D ≥ 0 in location of roots.
3) Using the infinite GP sum formula when |r| ≥ 1.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Level 2 shifts to visual analysis (parabolas), bounding roots (location of roots), inequalities (AM-GM), and solving combined series like AGP.

tricks.title: Maximum/Minimum Value of Quadratic
tricks.explanation: Occurs exactly at the vertex. Min value (if a>0) or Max value (if a<0) is -D/4a.

tricks.title: AM-GM Quick Check for Reciprocals
tricks.explanation: For any positive real number x, x + 1/x ≥ 2.
tricks.example: Minimum value of (x + 1/x) for x > 0 is exactly 2 (at x=1).

tricks.title: Infinite GP Sum Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Directly apply S = a / (1 - r) for decreasing geometric series.

tricks.title: Shifting Roots (Transformation)
tricks.explanation: To find an equation whose roots are α+k and β+k, replace x with (x-k) in the original equation.
